articles.title: QuFi launches post-quantum verification platform with Bitcoin testnet proof
articles.snippet: QuFi’s new platform uses post-quantum cryptography to verify digital asset transactions without requiring changes to existing blockchain settlement networks.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
articles.snippet: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.

articles.title: G7 Warns Quantum Threat Demands Action as Crypto Industry Weighs Fixes
articles.snippet: The group is urging organizations to adopt post-quantum security before powerful computers can compromise today’s encryption and digital signatures.
